# NoPoint

> NoPoint is an open-source runtime for building pitch decks as code. Slides are React components on a fixed 1280×720 design canvas, decks live in a registry, and an investor portal gates private decks behind a session cookie while keeping public decks freely shareable.

NoPoint is built on Next.js 16 (App Router) and is designed to be cloned and edited with AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex). The repo ships with a worked example seed deck, a Sequoia 10-slide template, recreations of historical decks (Airbnb 2009, Buffer 2013), and an information-memorandum template. Slide context (purpose, principles, what-it-is-not, story thread) is encoded directly on each slide so AI editors can read and edit without losing the deck's intent.

## Project

- [Homepage](https://nopoint.app/): What NoPoint is and the public deck library.
- [Get started](https://nopoint.app/getting-started): Clone, run locally, and use Claude Code / Cursor / Codex to import an existing deck.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/mewc/nopoint): Source code, issues, license.

## Public decks

- [Seed Round 2026](https://nopoint.app/investors/decks/seed-2026): NoPoint's own live seed pitch deck — the worked example for the format.
- [Sequoia 10-Slide Template](https://nopoint.app/investors/decks/sequoia): Sequoia Capital's "writing a business plan" 10-slide framework as starter slides.
- [AirBed & Breakfast — Seed 2009](https://nopoint.app/investors/decks/airbnb): Recreation of the original Airbnb seed deck for study.
- [Buffer — Seed 2013](https://nopoint.app/investors/decks/buffer): Recreation of Buffer's seed deck.
- [Chartpasta](https://nopoint.app/investors/decks/chartpasta): Companion deck for the Chartpasta / Chartcastr chart-embedding sub-product.
- [RR Diner Situation Room](https://nopoint.app/investors/decks/rr-diner): Themed sample deck.

## Conventions

- Slides live under `components/decks/<deck-id>/slides/` as React components.
- Each slide has an optional `context` field (`category`, `principles`, `goals`, `whatItIsNot`, `nailsThis`, `storyThread`) that the in-app Context widget reads at runtime — and that AI editors must keep honest when editing a slide.
- Decks ship with `DECK.md` (principles, slide plan, hard rules) and `REFERENCES.md` (citation table).
- Public decks are listed in `lib/decks/visibility.ts`. Anything not listed there stays gated behind investor credentials.
- Slides are authored against a fixed 1280×720 canvas; the viewer scales to fit. Do not use Tailwind responsive prefixes inside slides.
